page.title: Listing a Property (step-by-step)
page.description: Expand your digital real estate portfolio by learning how to effortlessly upload your inventory to the Smart MLS ecosystem. This guide provides the strategic workflow needed to position your properties for maximum visibility across the co-broking network - completely free of charge.
page.body:
Listing a Property: Step-by-Step Workflow


PropertyList empowers you to instantly share your properties with a vast network of real estate professionals, seamlessly integrating your inventory into their workflows and vice versa. As a verified agent, you have the strategic advantage of uploading unlimited listings to the Smart MLS without any upfront costs or monthly subscriptions.

This step-by-step guide outlines the optimal workflow for deploying a new mandate to the grid, ensuring it captures maximum attention from active deal makers.


Phase 1: Accessing the Listing Module

The PropertyList infrastructure is designed to be fully desktop and mobile-friendly, allowing you to deploy new listings from the office or directly from your smartphone while out in the field.

Sign In: Access your PropertyList account and navigate to the main MLS dashboard.

Initiate: Select the "LIST PROPERTY" tab to begin the upload process. (Strategic Tip: Ensure your company and staff accounts are properly configured if you wish to assign a specific team member to manage the mandate.)


Phase 2: Comprehensive Data Entry

The visibility of your property on the shared grid is heavily influenced by the quality and depth of your data.

Core Details: Input the exact location, property type, and orientation.

Strategic Descriptions: Provide highly detailed property descriptions. The internal Smart Search algorithm scans these descriptions, so comprehensive details will make your listing significantly easier to find by co-broking agents.

Features: Accurately select all relevant amenities - such as a private pool, sea views, or ducted central A/C - to ensure your property appears in advanced filtered searches.


Phase 3: High-Quality Media

Visual Assets: Upload high-resolution photographs of the property. Superior image quality directly increases your listing's priority and appeal.

Virtual Tours: Add a direct link to the property's video tour to provide an immersive experience for potential buyers.


Phase 4: Pricing and Co-Broking Terms

Financial Details: Enter the sale or rental price, along with associated costs such as IBI, Basura (trash collection), and community fees.

Commission Structure: Clearly insert the commission percentage or split you are offering to the co-broking agent. Transparent commission structures are essential for frictionless collaboration within the network.


Phase 5: Publishing and Strategic Distribution

Once your property details, media, and pricing are verified, publish the listing to the shared MLS grid.

Instant Sharing: Upon publishing, your property becomes available to the entire active network.

MicroSite Generation: The system will automatically generate a free, branded MicroSite - a dedicated URL link featuring your property and a built-in lead capture form. You can instantly share this link across your social media channels or directly with clients to capture valuable direct leads.


Pro-Tip: Maintain Data Integrity

To maintain a clean and efficient marketplace, PropertyList monitors for duplicate properties. Always ensure you hold the correct legal documentation, such as a signed listing agreement and proof of ownership, before uploading an exclusive mandate to the platform.

(Note: If you need to deploy a large portfolio quickly, you can also explore our Import Properties feature to automatically sync your existing database.)
